qs.stem: A committee of 3 is chosen from 6 men and 6 women. The number of committees containing at least one woman is
qs.trap: Counting a committee with two women twice (choose one woman, then anyone).

qs.stem: Two fair dice are thrown. The probability that the sum is 7 given that at least one die shows 5 is
steps: Outcomes with at least one 5: 11 (out of 36).
Of these, the sum is 7 in 2 cases.
qs.trap: Dividing by 36 instead of by the reduced sample space.

qs.stem: For the vectors a = 3i −3j −2k and b = 2i −3j −1k, |a × b|<sup>2</sup> equals
qs.trap: Using + (a·b)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 10 terms of the arithmetic progression 2, 7, 12, … is
qs.trap: Using nd instead of (n − 1)d.

qs.stem: The value of i + i<sup>2</sup> + i<sup>3</sup> + … + i<sup>30</sup> is
steps: Every block of four consecutive powers of i adds up to 0.
30 = 4 × 7 + 2, so only the last 2 term(s) remain.
qs.trap: Forgetting that i + i<sup>2</sup> + i<sup>3</sup> + i<sup>4</sup> = 0.

qs.stem: The area (in square units) of the region bounded by y = x<sup>2</sup> and y = 18x is
steps: The curves meet at x = 0 and x = 18.
qs.trap: Forgetting to subtract the area under the parabola.

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→0</sub> sin(4x)/(5x) equals
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: The number of solutions of sin x = 1/2 in the interval [0, 2π] is
steps: Write the general solution and count the values of x that fall in [0, 2π], including both end points.
qs.trap: Missing an end point of the closed interval.

qs.stem: The distance between the foci of the ellipse x<sup>2</sup>/25 + y<sup>2</sup>/9 = 1 is
steps: a<sup>2</sup> = 25, b<sup>2</sup> = 9 so c<sup>2</sup> = a<sup>2</sup> − b<sup>2</sup> = 16, c = 4.
qs.trap: Giving c instead of 2c.

qs.stem: The number of reflexive relations on a set with 4 elements is
steps: Each of the 4 diagonal pairs must be present.
The other 12 pairs are free: 2<sup>12</sup> = 4096 relations.
qs.trap: Counting all 2<sup>k<sup>2</sup></sup> relations.

qs.stem: The determinant of the matrix with rows [−3 4 0]   [−2 −2 2]   [0 −1 4] is
steps: Expand along the first row: a(ei − fh) − b(di − fg) + c(dh − eg).
qs.trap: Sign slip on the middle term of the expansion.

qs.stem: The sum of the order and the degree of the differential equation d<sup>3</sup>y/dx<sup>3</sup> + (dy/dx)<sup>3</sup> + y<sup>4</sup> = 0 is
steps: Degree = power of that highest derivative once the equation is a polynomial in derivatives = 1.
qs.trap: Taking the largest power anywhere as the degree.

qs.stem: If tan A = 1/5 and tan B = 1/5, then tan(A + B) is
steps: tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B)/(1 − tan A tan B).
qs.trap: Using + in the denominator.

qs.stem: If the sum of the first n terms of a sequence is S<sub>n</sub> = 4n<sup>2</sup> + 2n, the 12<sup>th</sup> term is
qs.trap: Taking T<sub>k</sub> = S<sub>k</sub>.

qs.stem: If f(x) = x<sup>3</sup> − 3x<sup>2</sup> + 3x, then f′(2) equals
qs.trap: Evaluating f instead of f′.

qs.stem: The distance of the point (-2, 1, -1) from the plane 4x + 4y + 7z + 29 = 0 is
steps: Distance = |ax<sub>1</sub> + by<sub>1</sub> + cz<sub>1</sub> + d|/√(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup>).
qs.trap: Forgetting the square-root denominator.

qs.stem: For a binomial distribution the mean is 9 and the variance is 27/4. The number of trials n is
steps: Mean = np and variance = npq, so q = variance/mean = 3/4 and p = 1/4.
qs.trap: Taking n = mean or n = mean + variance.

qs.stem: For z<sub>1</sub> = 6 + 3i and z<sub>2</sub> = 6 + 2i, the value of |z<sub>1</sub>z<sub>2</sub>|<sup>2</sup> is
qs.trap: Adding the squared moduli instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: The distance of the point (-3, 5) from the line 6x + 8y − 12 = 0 is
qs.trap: Forgetting to divide by √(a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>).

qs.stem: The number of distinct arrangements of all the letters of the word PEPPER is
steps: The word has 6 letters. Repeated letters: P×3 E×2.
qs.trap: Not dividing by the factorial of each repeated letter.

qs.stem: If A is a 3 × 3 matrix with det A = 5, then det(adj A) equals
qs.trap: Using (det A)<sup>n</sup>.

qs.stem: If dy/dx = 5y with y(0) = 3, then y(ln 4 / 5) equals
steps: At x = ln 4/5: e<sup>ln 4</sup> = 4, so y = 3 × 4 = 12.
qs.trap: Evaluating e<sup>kx</sup> as x instead of e<sup>ln m</sup> = m.

qs.stem: The sum of the first 4 terms of the geometric progression 3, 6, 12, … is
qs.trap: Using r<sup>n+1</sup> instead of r<sup>n</sup>.

qs.stem: lim<sub>x→2</sub> (x<sup>4</sup> − 16)/(x − 2) equals
steps: The limit is the derivative of x<sup>4</sup> at x = 2.
qs.trap: Writing a<sup>m</sup> instead of a<sup>m−1</sup>.

qs.stem: The radius of the circle x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> − 10x − 8y + 32 = 0 is
steps: Compare with x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0: g = −5, f = −4, c = 32.
qs.trap: Reporting r<sup>2</sup> instead of r.

qs.stem: A spring of force constant 500 N/m is compressed by 0.4 m. The energy stored in it is (in J)
qs.trap: Forgetting the ½, or not squaring x.

qs.stem: An object is placed 9 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 6 cm. The image is formed at a distance (in cm) of
qs.trap: Using u as a positive number in the lens formula.

qs.stem: A system absorbs 390 J of heat and does 340 J of work on its surroundings. The change in its internal energy is (in J)
qs.trap: Adding work done by the system to the heat absorbed.

qs.stem: A car moving at 30 m/s is brought to rest by a uniform retardation of 5 m/s<sup>2</sup>. The distance travelled before stopping is (in m)
qs.trap: Forgetting the factor 2 in 2as.

qs.stem: Resistors of 6 Ω and 3 Ω in parallel are connected in series with a 4 Ω resistor across a 12 V battery of negligible resistance. The current drawn from the battery is (in A)
qs.trap: Adding all three resistances in series.

qs.stem: The dimensional formula of (mass ÷ pressure) is
qs.trap: Adding exponents when dividing.

qs.stem: The energy of the electron in the n = 2 orbit of a Li<sup>2+</sup> ion is (in eV)
qs.trap: Using Z instead of Z<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: A body weighs 200 N on the surface of the earth (radius R). Its weight at a height of R above the surface is (in N)
steps: g′ = g R<sup>2</sup>/(R + h)<sup>2</sup> = g/(1 + h/R)<sup>2</sup> = g/4.
qs.trap: Dividing by (R + h) instead of (R + h)<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: Two capacitors of 4 μF and 4 μF are connected in series. The equivalent capacitance is (in μF)
qs.trap: Mixing up the series and parallel formulas.

qs.stem: An ideal transformer has 1000 turns in the primary and 100 in the secondary. The primary current is 3 A. The secondary current is (in A)
steps: Ideal transformer: V<sub>p</sub>I<sub>p</sub> = V<sub>s</sub>I<sub>s</sub>, so I<sub>s</sub>/I<sub>p</sub> = N<sub>p</sub>/N<sub>s</sub>.
qs.trap: Using the voltage ratio for currents.

qs.stem: A rotating platform has moment of inertia 10 kg m<sup>2</sup> and angular speed 6 rad/s. A person on it changes the moment of inertia to 4 kg m<sup>2</sup> without any external torque. The new angular speed is (in rad/s)
steps: Angular momentum is conserved: I<sub>1</sub>ω<sub>1</sub> = I<sub>2</sub>ω<sub>2</sub>.
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio of the moments of inertia.

qs.stem: The absolute pressure at a depth of 2 m in a liquid of density 13600 kg/m<sup>3</sup>, with atmospheric pressure 1.0 × 10<sup>5</sup> Pa and g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, is (in kPa)
qs.trap: Leaving out atmospheric pressure.

qs.stem: A 1 kg mass attached to a spring of constant 225 N/m oscillates with amplitude 3 cm. Its maximum speed is (in cm/s)
qs.trap: Using ω<sup>2</sup> instead of ω.

qs.stem: Two masses 5 kg and 3 kg hang from a light string over a smooth pulley (Atwood machine). Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the tension in the string is (in N)
qs.trap: Taking the tension equal to the weight of the heavier mass.

qs.stem: A radioactive sample has half-life 5 days and initially 800 nuclei (in thousands). The number remaining after 15 days is (in thousands)
qs.trap: Dividing by the number of half-lives rather than by 2 raised to it.

qs.stem: In Young's double-slit experiment the slit separation is 0.4 mm, the screen is 2 m away and the wavelength is 600 nm. The fringe width is (in mm)
qs.trap: Unit slip between nm, mm and m.

qs.stem: A wave of frequency 680 Hz has wavelength 0.5 m. Its speed is (in m/s)
qs.trap: Dividing instead of multiplying.

qs.stem: In measuring kinetic energy K = ½mv<sup>2</sup>, the mass has a 2% error and the speed a 1% error. The maximum percentage error in K is
qs.trap: Not doubling the speed error for v<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: A straight wire of length 0.2 m carrying 3 A is placed in a uniform magnetic field of 1 T at 30° to the field. The force on the wire is (in N)
qs.trap: Leaving out sinθ (or using cosθ).

qs.stem: A body is projected with speed 30 m/s at an angle whose sine is 0.8. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the maximum height reached is (in m)
qs.trap: Using the full speed instead of the vertical component.

qs.stem: A 5 kg block is pulled on a rough horizontal floor (μ = 0.2) by a horizontal force of 40 N through 20 m. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, the gain in kinetic energy is (in J)
steps: Net work = (F − f)d = (40 − 10) × 20 = 600 J = gain in K.E.
qs.trap: Ignoring the work done against friction.

qs.stem: A fixed mass of ideal gas goes from (P = 2 atm, V = 3 L, T = 300 K) to a state with P = 4 atm and V = 5 L. The final temperature is (in K)
qs.trap: Inverting the ratio.

qs.stem: Light of wavelength 155 nm falls on a metal of work function 3 eV (hc = 1240 eV nm). The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons is (in eV)
qs.trap: Giving the photon energy instead of the kinetic energy.

qs.stem: A block slides down a rough incline of angle 37° (sin 37° = 0.6, cos 37° = 0.8) with coefficient of friction 0.5. Taking g = 10 m/s<sup>2</sup>, its acceleration is (in m/s<sup>2</sup>)
qs.trap: Swapping sinθ and cosθ.

qs.stem: Two trains of lengths 150 m and 100 m move towards each other on parallel tracks at 20 m/s and 30 m/s. They take how many seconds to cross each other completely?
qs.trap: Using the difference of speeds (that is for the same direction).

qs.stem: From the reaction N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> → 2NH<sub>3</sub>, the mass of NH<sub>3</sub> formed from 140 g of nitrogen (completely reacted) is (in g)
steps: 1 mol of nitrogen gives 2 mol of NH<sub>3</sub>, so moles of NH<sub>3</sub> = 10.
qs.trap: Ignoring the mole ratio in the balanced equation.

qs.stem: The number of different dipeptides that can be formed from 5 different amino acids (each may be used more than once) is
qs.trap: Using k(k − 1), which does not allow repeats.

qs.stem: For hydrogen-like species, the ratio of the radius of the n = 3 orbit to that of the n = 2 orbit (same species) is
qs.trap: Using r ∝ n instead of n<sup>2</sup>.

qs.stem: The steric number (bond pairs + lone pairs) of the central atom in BF<sub>3</sub>, which has a trigonal planar shape, is
steps: 3 bond pairs and 0 lone pairs on B.
qs.trap: Ignoring the lone pairs.

qs.stem: The mass of nickel (molar mass 58.5 g/mol, ion charge 2+) deposited by passing 579000 C of charge is (in g; F = 96500 C/mol)
qs.trap: Ignoring the charge on the ion.

qs.stem: Given A → B, ΔH = −21 kJ and B → C, ΔH = −97 kJ, the enthalpy change for 2A → 2C is (in kJ)
steps: Multiplying the equation by 2 multiplies ΔH: -236 kJ.
qs.trap: Not scaling ΔH by the stoichiometric factor.

qs.stem: A first-order reaction has 512 g of reactant initially. After 5 half-lives the amount left is (in g)
steps: After each half-life the amount halves.
qs.trap: Dividing by the number of half-lives instead of 2 raised to it.

qs.stem: Liquids A and B form an ideal solution of 1 mol A and 4 mol B. Their vapour pressures when pure are 200 mm Hg and 300 mm Hg. The total vapour pressure of the solution is (in mm Hg)
qs.trap: Averaging the two pure vapour pressures without weighting by mole fraction.

qs.stem: The rate law of a substitution reaction is rate = k[RX]. If the concentrations of both RX and Nu<sup>−</sup> are multiplied by 3, the rate changes by a factor of
steps: The rate depends only on the species present in the rate law, each to its own power.
qs.trap: Counting a species that is not in the rate law.

qs.stem: The degree of unsaturation (double-bond equivalents) of C<sub>5</sub>H<sub>5</sub>N is
steps: DBE = (2C + 2 + N − H − X)/2 (oxygen does not count).
qs.trap: Counting oxygen or forgetting that N adds 1.

qs.stem: The number of moles of H<sub>2</sub> needed to hydrogenate 1 mole of but-1-yne completely is
steps: Add 1 mol H<sub>2</sub> per C=C (or per ring in a saturated ring), 2 mol per C≡C, and 3 mol per benzene ring.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as taking one mole.

qs.stem: Among N, Na, K, C, the element with the highest electronegativity (Pauling scale) is
steps: Pauling values: N 3.0, Na 0.9, K 0.8, C 2.5.
qs.trap: Reading the trend down a group the wrong way.

qs.stem: For N<sub>2</sub> + 3H<sub>2</sub> ⇌ 2NH<sub>3</sub> the equilibrium concentrations are [N<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M, [H<sub>2</sub>] = 1 M and [NH<sub>3</sub>] = 8 M. The value of K<sub>c</sub> is
qs.trap: Writing the ratio upside-down or ignoring the stoichiometric powers.

qs.stem: The coordination number of the metal in [Cr(H<sub>2</sub>O)<sub>6</sub>]<sup>3+</sup> is
steps: Coordination number = number of donor atoms attached to the metal = 6.
qs.trap: Counting ligands where some are bidentate.

qs.stem: The number of bonds in all (σ and π together) in propene (CH<sub>3</sub>CH=CH<sub>2</sub>) is
steps: Every bond has one σ bond; each double bond adds one π bond and each triple bond adds two.
qs.trap: Counting a triple bond as one π bond.

qs.stem: The number of different monochloro structural isomers obtainable from 2,2-dimethylbutane by free-radical chlorination (ignore stereoisomers) is
steps: Count the sets of equivalent hydrogens: each set gives one monochloro product.
qs.trap: Counting every hydrogen as different.

qs.stem: The depression in freezing point of a 0.2 m aqueous solution of NaCl (assume complete dissociation) is (K<sub>f</sub> = 1.86 K kg/mol; in K)
steps: ΔT<sub>f</sub> = i K<sub>f</sub> m with van't Hoff factor i = 2.
qs.trap: Using i = 1 for an electrolyte.

qs.stem: The number of radial nodes in a 2s orbital is
qs.trap: Counting n − l (forgetting to subtract 1).

qs.stem: The oxidation number of Cr in CrO<sub>4</sub><sup>2−</sup> is
steps: Assign O = −2 (or the usual values) and balance the total charge.
qs.trap: Forgetting the overall charge on the ion.

qs.stem: The mass of glucose (C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>12</sub>O<sub>6</sub>) required to prepare 500 mL of a 0.2 M solution is (in g)
qs.trap: Using the volume in mL without converting to litres.

qs.stem: The number of structural isomers (ignoring stereoisomers) of the amine C<sub>3</sub>H<sub>9</sub>N (all amines) is
steps: Enumerate carbon skeletons, then place the functional group.
qs.trap: Missing a branched skeleton or counting stereoisomers.

qs.stem: A buffer contains an acid HA (pK<sub>a</sub> = 4) and its salt with [A<sup>−</sup>]/[HA] = 10. Its pH is
qs.trap: Inverting the salt/acid ratio.

qs.stem: The number of moles of O<sub>2</sub> required for complete combustion of 1 mole of the hydrocarbon C<sub>7</sub>H<sub>4</sub> is
qs.trap: Using y/2 instead of y/4.

qs.stem: For a reaction A + B → products, doubling [A] alone raises the rate 4 times, and doubling [B] alone raises it 2 times. The overall order of the reaction is
steps: Rate ∝ [A]<sup>x</sup>[B]<sup>y</sup>: 2<sup>x</sup> = 4 gives x = 2 and 2<sup>y</sup> = 2 gives y = 1.
qs.trap: Adding the rate factors instead of the exponents.

qs.stem: 100 mL of a 3 M solution is diluted until its molarity is 0.5 M. The final volume of the solution is (in mL)
qs.trap: Giving the volume of water added instead of the final volume.
